description: This Java class demonstrates HTML content printing from an off-screen WebView in an Android app. It includes logic for initializing a WebView, loading local HTML content, and invoking the Android print framework to print the loaded content, with cleanup after printing.

classes.name: PrintHtmlOffScreen
classes.description: An Android Activity class that implements off-screen HTML content printing using WebView and the system print framework.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the layout, and prepares the WebView for printing.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Inflates the menu to add printing options.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles menu item selections to trigger printing.

methods.name: print
methods.description: Sets up the WebView, loads the HTML content, and initiates the print process after page load.

methods.name: doPrint
methods.description: Configures and invokes the Android printing framework, creating a print adapter from WebView content and handling cleanup post-printing.
